main.description: Subject for surveys following a Protocol.

scope.description: One or more scope criteria defining what this target is.

taxonScope.description: A taxonomic criterion for a survey target. The optional kingdom through family fields and higherClassification follow the Darwin Core terms of the same names and are used to sort and group targets taxonomically.

taxonID.description: Identifier for the target taxon, preferably a stable URI, e.g. https://www.gbif.org/species/102151594.

scientificName.description: Full scientific name without rank modifiers.

vernacularName.description: Common or vernacular name for the taxon, following dwc:vernacularName. Set by the protocol author as the preferred label shown to surveyors.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank, e.g. family, genus, subspecies, variety.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom. Combined with scientificName and taxonRank, provides disambiguation for most homonyms.

phylum.description: Full scientific name of the phylum in which the taxon is classified, following dwc:phylum.

class.description: Full scientific name of the class in which the taxon is classified, following dwc:class.

order.description: Full scientific name of the order in which the taxon is classified, following dwc:order.

family.description: Full scientific name of the family in which the taxon is classified, following dwc:family.

higherClassification.description: Names of the taxon's higher taxa, from highest to the one immediately above the taxon, separated by ' | ', following dwc:higherClassification, e.g. 'Animalia | Chordata | Mammalia | Artiodactyla | Whippomorpha | Cetacea | Mysticeti | Balaenopteridae | Megaptera'. Includes ranks that have no field of their own, so targets can be sorted by their full lineage.

verbatimScope.description: A free-text criterion for cases not covered by structured types (sensu Humboldt eco:verbatimTargetScope).

verbatimTargetScope.description: Free-text description of what is being targeted, e.g. 'trees > 10 cm DBH'.
